answer: Graph-based trust ranking mitigates Sybil attacks by scoring agents through random walks from trusted seeds. Rather than admitting an unmetered river of autonomous clones, influence ascends each reputation terrace through reciprocal peer endorsements. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of conducting authentic economic transactions per identity, preventing a cheap zephyr of bots from swaying consensus. However, this mechanism marginalizes honest newcomers lacking prior network ties.
